page.title: Practical technology work, organized around the problem.
page.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works combines focused project work with bounded ongoing care. The goal is to improve what exists, add only what earns its place, and leave ownership understandable.

families.name: Websites & Website Care
families.description: Build or modernize an accessible, maintainable business website, then keep it healthy through clearly scoped ongoing care when useful.

families.name: Business Systems & Automation
families.description: Reduce repetitive work, connect existing systems, and build focused internal tooling only when configuration and integration leave a real gap.

families.name: Digital Ownership & Platform Administration
families.description: Untangle domains, DNS, hosting, repositories, business profiles, vendor access, and the ongoing administration needed to keep those systems recoverable.

families.name: Technology Consulting
families.description: Architecture, troubleshooting, platform choices, technical planning, and practical decision support without a predetermined product sale.

startingPoints.title: Improve an existing system
startingPoints.description: Keep the useful parts, identify the friction, and modernize only where the change earns its cost.

startingPoints.title: Build a focused capability
startingPoints.description: Start with the business need and choose the smallest maintainable implementation that solves it.

startingPoints.title: Untangle ownership or vendors
startingPoints.description: Clarify who owns critical systems, who has access, how recovery works, and what a safe transition should look like.

platformNote.title: Not every project needs another platform.
platformNote.body: Native features, maintained SaaS, open formats, portable repositories, and low recurring costs are preferred when they meet the requirement. Databases, custom authentication, new frameworks, and paid tools should earn their place.
